products.name: EX Power Keepers Booster Box
products.note: 36 packs of 9 cards, no code card (Potomac Distribution box page and TCGplayer's pack text). TCGplayer lists the box without a market price, so it is priced at 36 packs.

products.name: EX Power Keepers Single Blister Pack
products.note: One booster pack in a blister (TCGplayer's product text: "Each blister comes with a booster pack containing 9 cards"; no promo is named). TCGplayer lists it without a market price, so it is priced at one pack.
